chapter_title: Concerning the Five Wonders that the Light Mind sh
spiritual_reading: The Divine understanding will bring a sufficient complement of clear operations into those who are being received into heaven. The Divine understanding implants these operations into the regenerated person after removing defilements, setting falsities aside, sustaining the new life by continual influx of good and truth, and distinguishing that person for conjunction with itself.

fills.notes: Accept the existing restoration. In the substrate register the Light Mind (Divine understanding) first forms the ‘new man’ by prior acts of separation: purification and cleansing. The relative clause marks that the subject acted upon is already made receptive before the five signs are implanted.

The sequence ‘purified, cleansed, supported and chosen’ demands an additional clause that names what is being removed in the oldest cosmological logic: not moral guilt or ecclesial status, but admixture. In the Persian correspondential substrate, purification and cleansing are the unmingling of Light from Darkness; support is sustaining the separated Light by influx; choice is distinction for conjunction. Thus the missing object is the remaining ‘mixture with Darkness’ from which the new man is separated before the signs are set within him.

assessment: One lacuna is an editor’s secure small restoration. The larger gap is constrained by the correspondential sequence: separation (purify, cleanse) must specify removal of admixture with Darkness prior to implantation of the five signs. Exact wording is not recoverable, but the demanded cosmological content is tight.
